inputs.text: {"scene":"A flat, straight-on presentation board for the fictional cloud software company NIMBRA, photographed as a clean digital mockup sheet on a pure white background. The sheet has six main rectangular zones in a two-row, three-column grid, separated by thin light-grey hairlines; several zones are subdivided into smaller labelled modules. Each module label sits at its upper left in tiny grey uppercase text. The upper-left zone contains three vertically stacked modules labelled \"PRIMARY LOGO\", \"ALTERNATE LOGO\" and \"APP ICON\". The primary logo is the wordmark \"NIMBRA\" in a modern geometric sans-serif, preceded by two overlapping rounded clouds, a pale-periwinkle rear cloud and a saturated-indigo-blue front cloud. The alternate logo repeats this lockup at a smaller size. The app icon is the cloud mark alone in white on a rounded-corner navy tile. The upper-middle zone contains two stacked modules labelled \"REVERSED LOGO\" and \"BUSINESS CARD\". The reversed logo is the white \"NIMBRA\" lockup on a solid navy card. The business card is white and bears the small cloud mark, \"ALEX MORGAN\" in bold dark type, \"HEAD OF PLATFORM\" beneath it, and three tiny grey contact lines reading \"alex@nimbra.com\", \"+1 415 555 0148\" and \"nimbra.com\". The upper-right zone occupies the entire right half of the top row and is labelled \"HOMEPAGE MOCKUP\"; it contains a browser window with a thin navigation bar, five small menu words \"HOME\", \"PLATFORM\", \"SOLUTIONS\", \"RESOURCES\", \"PRICING\", and a blue pill-shaped \"GET STARTED\" button. The headline reads \"WORK BETTER.\" on the first line and \"FROM ANYWHERE.\" on the second, with \"FROM\" near-black and \"ANYWHERE.\" indigo. Two short grey body-text lines read \"Your work, connected in one place.\" and \"Move projects forward from anywhere.\" Below them are a solid indigo \"TRY FREE\" button and an outlined \"BOOK A DEMO\" button. A pale dashboard card floats to the right of the headline, with a small rising line chart and the large legible figure \"98.6%\". Across the bottom row, the left zone is labelled \"COLOUR PALETTE\" and displays exactly five swatch rectangles in one row, left to right: near-black navy, saturated indigo, soft periwinkle, pale lavender and off-white. Beneath each swatch are two tiny grey lines with its name and hex code: \"NAVY\" / \"#11152E\", \"INDIGO\" / \"#4B3CDB\", \"PERIWINKLE\" / \"#A9B5F4\", \"LAVENDER\" / \"#E9E5FA\", and \"OFF-WHITE\" / \"#F8F8F6\". The bottom-middle zone is labelled \"TYPOGRAPHY\" and shows a very large \"Aa\", the typeface name \"INTER\", and four progressively smaller specimen lines: \"The quick brown fox\", \"Jumps over the lazy dog\", \"0123456789\", and \"Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee\". The bottom-right zone is divided into a narrow module labelled \"ICONOGRAPHY\", containing exactly ten thin-line outline icons in two rows of five, ordered cloud, shield, user, clock, message, folder, document, sliders, bell and grid, and a module labelled \"PACKAGING\", showing a matte navy cube-shaped box in soft three-quarter perspective. Its front face carries the white cloud mark and \"NIMBRA\" wordmark, with two small white lines near the lower edge reading \"SECURE CLOUD STORAGE\" and \"BUILT FOR TEAMS\". Centered directly beneath the entire sheet, one small dark line reads \"BRAND GUIDELINES 2024\".
